Lecture lines:
Determinants define the signed area of a parallelogram.
Vectors define the parallelogram's sides.
[Asset: UnitSquareToParallelogram] The transformation scales area.

Planned animations:
Create a Dot at origin with color #FF0000.
Draw a Square around the Dot with color #00FF00.
Flash the Square to emphasize the unit area.
Fade out the Dot and Square.
Display a MathTex area formula at #FFFFFF.

Section: section_2 — Framing the Linear System

Lecture lines:
Linear systems represent vector combinations.
Solve for weights x and y.
[Asset: DroneTargetVectors] Reach point b using v1, v2.

Planned animations:
Create two vectors as Arrows from center in #FFFF00.
Transform vectors to form a parallelogram.
Highlight the parallelograms region in #0000FF.

Section: section_3 — The Geometry of Cramer's Rule

Lecture lines:
Cramer's Rule relates areas.
Replace columns to define new parallelograms.
[Asset: ParallelogramReplacement] Ratio of areas equals the coordinate.

Planned animations:
Display equations for x and y variables in #FFFFFF.
Replace the column of the system matrix.
Show the determinant ratio on screen in #FF00FF.

Section: section_4 — The Visual Mechanism

Lecture lines:
Vary target b shifts areas.
Observe how areas expand and contract.
[Asset: AnimatedScaling] Scaling factor yields the solution.

Planned animations:
Draw unit grid in #888888.
Scale the grid area by the determinant.
Highlight the intersection point in #00FFFF.

Section: section_5 — Synthesis & Limitation

Lecture lines:
Determinant represents an area check.
Zero area means collinear vectors.
[Asset: FailureCase] Unique solutions vanish if area zero.

Planned animations:
Draw a summary table showing pros and cons.
Animate a checkmark of scale 1.0 next to advantages.
Flash the text to emphasize the final takeaway.

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        self.wait(2)
